a: First prize $4,000; second $700, third $600, fourth $500, fifth $400
dt: Essays due by midnight, March 31, 2027 (one PDF by email); awards announced May 15, 2027
e: Annual essay competition on gravitation: essays of up to 10 pages, one per author, written in English and not AI-generated. The five winning essays are published in a special issue of the International Journal of Modern Physics D; the rules state no eligibility limits.
n: Gravity Research Foundation Awards for Essays on Gravitation (2027)
unv: The rules page lists no restrictions on who may enter; whether co-authored essays count against each author's one-essay limit not checked
